approved: Foreign Affairs Portfolio Miscellaneous Measures Bill 2013

Introduced the Foreign Affairs Portfolio Miscellaneous Measures Bill, which lets Australian Secret Intelligence Service employees transfer between public service agencies while protecting their identity, and gives the ASIS director general power to modify Work Health and Safety Act provisions with ministerial approval.

Supported the Foreign Affairs Portfolio Miscellaneous Measures Bill, which lets ASIS employees transfer between public service agencies without disclosing their intelligence role, and gives the ASIS director general power to modify Work Health and Safety Act provisions, noting ASIS was established in 1952.

Summarised the Foreign Affairs Portfolio Miscellaneous Measures Bill's amendments to the Intelligence Services Act and Work Health and Safety Act, allowing ASIS employees to transfer between public service agencies while protecting their identities, and giving the ASIS director general power to modify safety act provisions with ministerial approval, matching arrangements already available to the Australian Defence Force and ASIO.
